rules.title: Area baseline quantification
rules.logic: Area-based baseline stock changes are accounted by applying the performance benchmark to estimated removals.

rules.title: Census baseline stock change
rules.logic: Census baseline stock change is zero because the baseline has no project planting units.

rules.title: Pre-existing woody biomass t0 methods
rules.logic: Area-based pre-existing woody biomass requires t=0 via preferred pre-preparation plots, eligible post-start plots, or a qualifying remote-sensing estimate using specified model, confidence-bound, correlation and spatial-resolution conditions.

rules.title: Pre-existing biomass removal conditions
rules.logic: Removal during site preparation requires a t=0 estimate, waste/no-commercial-value status, and no clearing or harvesting of natural forest, native tree species or commercially viable timber.

rules.title: Dead-wood t0 and disturbance accounting
rules.logic: Dead wood t=0 must be measured by plots before disturbance and no more than two years before start; project disturbance or removal must be quantified by stock difference.

rules.title: Delayed census biomass measurement
rules.logic: If first carbon-stock measurement occurs after t=0, that measurement replaces t=0 for stock-change calculations and change before it is zero; project start remains t=0 for other purposes.

rules.title: Complete census monitoring
rules.logic: Census woody biomass scales sampled per-unit biomass by N adjusted for mortality; monitoring of the complete census is required.

rules.title: Excluded census pools
rules.logic: Non-woody biomass, dead wood, litter and SOC are not applicable in census-based project carbon-stock quantification.

rules.title: Census fertilizer equations
rules.logic: Census nitrogen-fertilizer N2O emissions use Equations 15-21 from §8.2.2.2.

rules.title: Leakage by approach
rules.logic: Area-based leakage uses the most recent VMD0054; census leakage LKt is zero because pre-project production is maintained and density limits avoid displacement.

rules.title: Uncertainty scope
rules.logic: Sampling uncertainty is quantified and accounted; measurement error is handled via QA/QC; burning and fertilizer parameter uncertainty is set to zero under conservative parameters.

rules.title: Area uncertainty
rules.logic: Area-based projects must use measurement-appropriate standard methods for uncertainty for each included pool; Equation 28 applies when inventory method is maintained.

rules.title: Changed sampling uncertainty
rules.logic: Where area-based projects switch inventory approaches, combined uncertainty must follow Appendix 3.

rules.title: Census uncertainty
rules.logic: Census uncertainty propagates uncertainty in mortality-adjusted population and mean woody biomass using Equations 29-31.

rules.title: 100% confidence-width crediting stop
rules.logic: For either approach, CRt is zero where the half-width of the two-sided 90% confidence interval exceeds 100% of the removal estimate.

rules.title: Mixed-approach removals
rules.logic: Mixed-project removals equal the sum of independently calculated area- and census-based removals over non-overlapping areas.

rules.title: Harvesting LTA requirement
rules.logic: Projects with harvesting must follow the most recent VCS Standard long-term-average requirement as an upper limit on calculated removals.

rules.title: Annualization
rules.logic: Annualized removals equal monitoring-interval removals divided by interval length.

rules.title: Ex-ante estimation requirements
rules.logic: Project description must include ex-ante removals for the crediting period using conservative growth and yield inputs, modeled harvest or management, at least 10% uncertainty deduction, approach-specific equations and baselines, and area-based benchmark forecasting.
